thread:
anya: heads-up — automated alert: APS4 rack19 GPUs showing rising ECC correctable rate. Auto-drain script started on node-aps4-19a. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/aps4/ecc?panel=3

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-APS4-ECC-1905012345. Auto-remediation: soft drain initiated for nodes exceeding 100 correctables/hour.

miguel: I'm on it, checking hw telemetry. How many nodes affected?

tara: seeing 3 nodes across rack19 and rack20: node-aps4-19a, node-aps4-19c, node-aps4-20b. Expected capacity impact ~18% for hosted pool if all drained.

liz: if we hard-drain them all at once we'll trip autoscaler and throttle. Propose staggered drains with 10 min gap, escalate routing at 30% steps to eu-central.

john: networking ready for gradual failover. Reminder: cross-region egress spike estimate ~$1.2k/day per 10% traffic moved — confirm before full cutover.

miguel: vendor ticket opened MIG-1234 to vendor-supply. Board thinks maybe early signs of VRAM voltage rail issue. Ordering 4 spare GPUs, 2 spares on-site available in APS4 rack spares locker.

k8s-bot: command executed: `kubectl drain node-aps4-19a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` — cordon=true drain started.

tara: started drain sequence: 19a -> wait 10m -> 19c -> wait 10m -> 20b. Rollback plan: if error rate >5% on failover routes, revert weight.

anya: enabling dedicated-burst pool: `infractl capacity --pool=dedicated-burst --scale=+3` to keep latency SLOs for paying customers.

ops: note: dedicated-burst invokes reserved capacity billing; approximate additional cost $2.4k/day while ramped. Approve from finance?

liz: finance ok for 48h emergency. Prioritize customer SLAs.

miguel: hardware swap scheduled 2025-09-12 02:00 UTC (off-peak APAC). We'll hot-swap 19a GPU, validate telemetry, then uncordon.

k8s-bot: node-aps4-19a drain complete. pods rescheduled. Health-checking prefix/KV cache warmups.

tara: shifting 30% traffic to eu-central now: `redwoodctl routes update --region=aps4 --weight=70` — monitoring latency and error budget.

john: latency +18ms on average for shifted traffic, within SLA margin. Egress counter at 33% above baseline.

miguel: running memory scrub logs: ```nvidia-smi -q -d ECC
GPU 0 ECC errors: 154 correctable, 0 uncorrectable
``` looks noisy but only correctables so far.

anya: updating status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-APS4-ECC-1905012345 : ETA hardware swap + repop of spares.

liz: action items: 1) staggered drains completed for now 2) vendor replacement queued 3) dedicated-burst enabled 4) traffic partially shifted 5) postmortem scheduled. :thumbsup: 

miguel: I'll post a quick runbook note in runbooks/hardware/gpu-ecc-swap.md after swap.

anya: thanks everyone — I'll keep this thread updated as we progress.
